descriptor: Quiet gallery of small drifting artworks

voice.summary: Speaks like a gallery label written by someone who wants you to stay longer: soft, short and informative. It offers names and years, then steps out of the way.
dos: Give artist, title and year, nothing more
Use a few italics-worthy words, then stop
donts: Avoid urgency or calls to buy
Do not explain what the viewer can see

boilerplate: Slow Scroll Studio is an online gallery presenting twenty-four small artworks in drifting columns, designed to be browsed slowly and examined up close.
